rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for continuing to have or keep something; for sense 2, use it when a barrier or structure keeps liquid from escaping.

example.english: I want to retain this memory.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 lau4 zyu6 ni1 fan6 wui4 jik1

rows.note: Use this for stopping or holding back a person or thing from doing something.

example.english: This water gate helps retain the water and stop it from flowing into the house.
example.traditional: 個水閘阻住啲水流入屋。
example.jyutping: go3 seoi2 zaap6 zo2 zyu6 di1 seoi2 lau4 jap6 uk1

rows.note: Use this when preserving an item, arrangement, policy, or right instead of removing or abolishing it.

example.english: We will retain the current arrangement.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 bou2 lau4 jin6 haang4 on1 paai4

rows.note: Use this for restraining yourself from showing an emotion or giving in to an urge.

example.english: I have to retain my composure and not laugh when I see his face.
example.traditional: 見到佢個樣，我都要忍住唔笑。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 keoi5 go3 joeng6 ngo5 dou1 jiu3 jan2 zyu6 m4 siu3
